title: College of Arts and Sciences bachelor rules
notes: Excerpts cover major-status admission, ordinary bachelor completion, overlap and the stated multilingual alternative. Distributed minors, second degrees, probation, honors and all special-curriculum detail are not exhaustively normalized.
Do not apply this set merely because a student takes an A&S course; the degree-awarding college must be A&S.

rules.label: Major-status credits
rules.statement: Complete at least 26 credits; transfer coursework may contribute.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Major-status GPA
rules.statement: Meet the 2.0 cumulative GPA rules. Continuing students need a 2.0 UNM cumulative GPA; transfer students use their first UNM semester to establish a 2.0 GPA.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Major-status Gen Ed areas
rules.statement: Complete Gen Ed Communication, Mathematics/Statistics and Second Language with C or CR or better.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Major admission coursework
rules.statement: Complete the major’s admission coursework with C or better; CR is not allowed for that major-admission coursework.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Transition to major status
rules.statement: After college and major-specific conditions are satisfied, the college processes transition from pre-major to major. Internal transfers initiate the process with the intended major advisor. Meeting criteria and recorded major status remain distinct.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Total degree credits
rules.statement: Complete 120 acceptable credits; these restate the University degree total, not another 120-credit block.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: College GPA
rules.statement: Meet at least a 2.0 GPA under the catalog grading definition.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

source_refs.anchor: grade point average of at least 2.00

rules.label: A&S-taught credits
rules.statement: Normally complete at least 90 credits taught by A&S academic units. The source also names Honors-credit treatment; see the case below.
rules.applies_when: A&S bachelor students using the standard 90-credit rule; the named Critical Studies in Mass Media exception uses as_credits_exception.

rules.label: A&S credit exception
rules.statement: The Critical Studies in Mass Media concentration in the Communication B.A. requires 80 A&S-taught credits instead of 90. Apply only to that named concentration.
rules.applies_when: The first major/concentration is the named Critical Studies in Mass Media route.

rules.label: Major/minor combination
rules.statement: Complete a major plus minor, a double major, or an approved special curriculum requiring no minor. The first major must be housed in A&S.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

children.label: Major and minor
children.statement: An A&S first major and an approved minor.

children.label: Double major
children.statement: Two majors, with the first housed in A&S.

children.label: Approved special curriculum
children.statement: An approved College special curriculum requiring no minor.

rules.label: Study after major-status transition
rules.statement: Complete one year of enrollment after transition to major status, earning at least 12 credits. Do not substitute two elapsed semesters or raw credit standing for the source’s one-year requirement.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Upper-division coursework
rules.statement: Normally complete at least 48 upper-division credits with at least a 2.0 GPA across upper-division credit accepted by A&S. This is a subset of degree credits.
rules.applies_when: The ordinary upper-division route; an approved Multilingual Recognition Option uses the published multilingual alternative.

rules.label: Multilingual alternative
rules.statement: An eligible Multilingual Recognition Option can use 42 upper-division credits with the required A&S language major/minor. Listed related interdisciplinary routes require advising confirmation; do not apply the reduction to every student.
rules.applies_when: The student qualifies for the published Multilingual Recognition Option.

rules.label: Major/minor grades
rules.statement: Require C or better in major/minor work, subject to stated academic-unit exceptions. C-minus or lower can be elective credit when acceptable but does not satisfy ordinary major/minor work.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Major/minor CR/NC
rules.statement: Do not use CR/NC major/minor courses unless the courses are offered only on that grading basis, subject to unit-specific policies.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Major/minor overlap
rules.statement: Ordinarily a course does not satisfy both major and minor. A supportive-coursework exception can permit it; obtain advising confirmation and preserve each program’s full required credit total.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Double-major overlap
rules.statement: For an A&S double major, at most 12 course credits can count toward both majors, and each major needs at least 24 unique credits. Count shared earned credits once toward the degree total.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Major/minor residence
rules.statement: Follow the University half-major and quarter-minor UNM residence rules; these are overlapping subsets, not additional degree credits.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Graduation planning workshop
rules.statement: Attend the Graduation Planning Workshop after completing 75 earned credits and submit the projected graduation date.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Gen Ed and cultures
rules.statement: Complete University Gen Ed and the University cultures requirement; use the shared University/Gen Ed sets rather than adding duplicate requirements here.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

attention.statement: The college page states that 18 Honors credits count as A&S credit but does not fully specify the interpretation of that allowance in this passage. Preserve it for advising; do not silently count unlimited Honors credits or manufacture an extra 18-credit requirement.
